blockingFindings.title: Rejects valid null requirementId findings
blockingFindings.issue: The impl review response contract still allows `requirementId` to be null when it does not apply, but `buildImplReviewResponseSchema()` now requires `requirementId` to be a non-empty string enum and `ImplReviewFinding` throws when it is missing. Valid structured review JSON containing `requirementId: null` will therefore be rejected before filtering or artifact creation.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In `buildImplReviewResponseSchema()` and `ImplReviewFinding`, keep `requirementId` nullable/optional per the contract, and only validate non-empty requirement IDs against the allowed set when one is provided.
blockingFindings.rationale: This is a direct behavior contradiction of the structured artifact contract and can block otherwise valid impl-review output.
